view.text: A footbridge crosses a black sluice. The water is empty. The far rail disappears into the fog.
view.holding: The hour was for a dry room. This water can hear.

view.text: A footbridge crosses a black sluice. Penry said not to stop on it. The far rail disappears into the fog.
view.holding: The hour was for a dry room. This water can hear.

location.asset: You look down. The sluice keeps what it has. No face turns.
You look down. The sluice keeps what it has. No face turns. Harbor water, Penry said, with a lid on.
A board peg is wedged in the grating, the kind that holds a boat's name. The letters cut in it are VOSS. It came down from the board on the water, not in a pocket.
location.ending: You read his hour to the sluice. The black water rises to the boards, and a pale face turns up where the water was empty.
